english_draft: Samsung Electronics reported Q2 2025 consolidated revenue of KRW 74.6 trillion, down 5.8% quarter on quarter, and operating profit of KRW 4.7 trillion. Device Solutions sales rose, but memory inventory adjustments and China export restriction costs weighed on profit. This analysis uses only the official IR release. No consensus, share price reaction, segment margins, or guidance are provided. There is no same-period preview; no historical reconstruction is presented as a forecast.
reader_questions: 环比下降 5.8% 主要由哪些业务造成？
Device Solutions 销售增长为何仍不足以抵消库存调整？
中国出口限制成本对营业利润的具体影响是多少？
fact_checks: 币种为韩元（KRW），不是美元或人民币。
期间为 2025 年第二季度，不是全年或 Q4 单季。
营收与营业利润为合并口径，来源为三星官方 IR 新闻稿。
